extracted.name: Creamy Broccoli Salad
extracted.description: This creamy broccoli salad recipe combines broccoli, bacon, red onion, and mozzarella cheese, tossed in a creamy dressing for a perfect picnic salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound fresh broccoli, cut into florets
instruction_lines: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels; crumble when cool.
Combine bacon, broccoli, mozzarella cheese, and onion in a bowl.
Whisk mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar in a small bowl until smooth and sugar dissolves; pour over broccoli mixture and toss to coat.
